notes:
PASS on the fake backend only; no hardware was attached and the upstream package was never installed, imported or run. The card's decision/helper (family gymnasium, GymnasiumDriver) expresses the interface, so there is no deviation from the card. The card's mock_strategy preferred upstream-sim, but the upstream simulator needs gym 0.19.0, pybullet 3.2.5 and tensorflow 1.14.0 (setup.py:6-24), so the package uses a package fake (driver-authoring.md section 6). The published contract is the continuous, non-simplified, depth-observation variant: action.values is five normalized numbers in [-1, 1] and reset takes seed only (RobotEnv.reset() takes no arguments; World.seed supplies the RNG). Other upstream configurations are not published: the simplified 3-D continuous and discrete action spaces, the 11-action discrete full variant, the 100/101-value encoder observations and the 64 x 64 x 5 RGB-D variant. The fake is kinematic: no pybullet dynamics, contacts, gravity, camera, TensorFlow encoder or upstream reward function; the reward is a constant 0.0 and the episode ends at a 150-tick stand-in horizon. It returns an 8 x 8 x 2 depth-plus-actuator observation stand-in while the real observation space is 64 x 64 x 2; the driver's fidelity gaps and facts name the real size, and the standard carries the observation as an open object. The fake was not compared with the upstream environment; no physical device or hardware was modelled or validated. The fidelity contract (analytic, F0, seeded with seed_control parameter, timestep 4.1667 ms, realtime_factor 0, lockstep clock, full reset, no snapshot) describes the fake as deployed, not the generic upstream engine. Expected warnings only: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the seed only fixes the next reset and the bridge tracks it) and four G8.NO_UNIT (the bridge-derived reset seed, seed input, ticks and action.values[*]); there were no G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warnings. No operator-required Limit and no site-limits overlay were needed: the only bounds are the action space derived from the fake's Box(-1, 1, (5,)) and the bridge's ticks 1 to 10000. No extension capability ids were used.
